description: Ornn Data gives ChatGPT live and historical market data for AI infrastructure: GPU rental price indices (spot, daily settles, rolling averages, volatility, volume, forward curve), memory (DRAM/flash/module) prices, token price indices by lab, LLM coding-activity indices, workload cost metrics, and neocloud datacenter site data. Users can look up current prices, chart historical trends, and compare markets across GPU types, memory types, labs, products, and regions.

defaultPrompt: What is the current price index of H100s?
